commits.subject: core: TOSLightLock now uses WaitOnAddress/WakeByAddressSingle on Win8+
commits.body:
- instead of the SRW lock which purpose is not this
- very high CAS fast path - just like TLIghtLock
- use of Windows 32-bit futex API only on contention
- the very same logic used on Linux did work directly!
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: fixed potential out of range in TAsyncConnections.ThreadPollingWakeupLocked;
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: core: fixed TOSLightLock usage comments in code
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: core: TOsLightLock uses a futex on Linux
commits.body:
- is as fast as TLightLock on its fast CAS path
- using a futex syscall is a perfect match in comparison with SpinAndWait/SwitchToThread
- fallback to TLightLock logic on very old kernel (from 20 years ago)
- validated against our TFB sample to give the best RPS with good stability
- it makes Linus happy
- but any feedback is welcome!
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez
